# anthropic_analytics_skills (Data Source)

Per-skill usage for a Claude Enterprise organization. Data is available from 2026-01-01 with about a one-day lag; the API allows 60 requests per minute per organization. Requires `analytics_api_key` (or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying `read:analytics`).

~> This is a point-in-time report that is re-read on every plan. Use it for outputs and policy checks, not to manage infrastructure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Skill usage rolled up over a week, per product surface.
data "anthropic_analytics_skills" "week" {
  starting_date = "2026-01-01"
  ending_date   = "2026-01-08"
  group_by      = ["product"]
  filters       = ["share_status:organization"]
  order_by      = "distinct_user_count"
  order         = "desc"
  limit_rows    = 25
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `date` (String) Single UTC day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Exactly one of `date` or `starting_date` must be set.
- `ending_date` (String) Exclusive last day of the range, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Only valid with `starting_date`; defaults to today.
- `filters` (List of String) Filters as `dimension:value`; repeat a dimension for OR, mix dimensions for AND. Dimensions: `product`, `rbac_group_id`, `share_status`, `skill_name`, `user_id`.
- `group_by` (List of String) Dimensions to break rows out by: `product`, `rbac_group_id`, `user_id`.
- `limit_rows` (Number) Maximum number of rows to keep after reading every page. Unlimited when omitted.
- `order` (String) Sort direction, `asc` or `desc`.
- `order_by` (String) Sort field: the endpoint's name column or one of its rankable metrics.
- `starting_date` (String) First day of a range, `YYYY-MM-DD` (rollup mode: one row per entity over the range).

### Read-Only

- `rows` (Attributes List) One row per skill (times group dimensions). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rows))

<a id="nestedatt--rows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rows`

Read-Only:

- `attributed_list_price` (String) List-price value of requests that involved the skill, minor units.
- `chat_distinct_conversation_skill_used_count` (Number) Distinct chat conversations that used the skill.
- `claude_code_distinct_session_skill_used_count` (Number) Distinct Claude Code sessions that used the skill.
- `cowork_distinct_session_skill_used_count` (Number) Distinct Cowork sessions that used the skill.
- `currency` (String) Currency of the monetary fields.
- `distinct_user_count` (Number) Distinct users who used the skill.
- `enable_count` (Number) Distinct accounts that enabled the skill that day; null on grouped or range rows.
- `estimated_overage_spend` (String) Estimated overage spend attributed to the skill, minor units as a decimal string.
- `invocation_count` (Number) Number of invocations; null when invocation reporting is not enabled.
- `office_excel_distinct_session_skill_used_count` (Number) Distinct Excel sessions that used the skill.
- `office_outlook_distinct_session_skill_used_count` (Number) Distinct Outlook sessions that used the skill.
- `office_powerpoint_distinct_session_skill_used_count` (Number) Distinct PowerPoint sessions that used the skill.
- `office_word_distinct_session_skill_used_count` (Number) Distinct Word sessions that used the skill.
- `product` (String) Product surface; present only when grouped by `product`.
- `rbac_group_id` (String) RBAC group id; present only when grouped by `rbac_group_id`.
- `rbac_group_name` (String) RBAC group name; null when the group was deleted or unresolved.
- `share_status` (String) `private`, `organization` or `public` (claude.ai only).
- `skill_display_name` (String) Resolved display name when `skill_name` is an opaque id.
- `skill_name` (String) Skill name, or an opaque skill id for private skills.
- `user_id` (String) User id; present only when grouped by `user_id`.
